intro: TaskBoard is a shared to-do board for a small team. Everyone signs in with their name, adds tasks, and ticks them off. Admins also manage categories and permissions.

member-basics/signin-page.text: Open TaskBoard in your browser. The first thing you see is the sign-in page.

levels.beginner: Open the TaskBoard link your team gave you. You will land on this sign-in page. Nothing is saved yet, so there is nothing to break.

member-basics/enter-name.text: Type your name in the **Your name** box. Your teammates see this name next to your work.

member-basics/choose-role.text: Choose **Team member** unless your team lead asked you to be an admin. Admins see an extra Settings page.

levels.beginner: Leave this on **Team member**. You only need **Admin** if you look after the team's settings.

member-basics/sign-in.text: Click **Sign in**. If you left your name empty, TaskBoard asks you to fill it in first.

member-basics/empty-board.text: This is your board. It is empty until someone adds a task.

member-basics/type-task.text: Click the box at the top and describe what needs doing, in a few words.

levels.power: Type the task title. Keep it short — the board shows one line per task.

member-basics/pick-category.text: Pick a category so the task is easy to find later. **General** is fine if nothing else fits.

member-basics/add-task.text: Click **Add task**, or press **Enter**. The task appears on the board straight away.

member-basics/task-added.text: Your new task is now on the board with its category next to it. Everyone on the team can see it.

member-basics/complete-task.text: When a task is finished, tick the box next to it. The task is crossed out and counted as done.

levels.beginner: Finished something? Tick the small box next to it. You can untick it again if you clicked by mistake.

member-advanced/counter.text: The counter shows how many tasks are still open and how many are done. It updates as you work.

member-advanced/filter-active.text: Click **Active** to hide finished tasks and see only what is left to do.

member-advanced/filter-done.text: Click **Done** to see only finished tasks — handy for a weekly round-up. Click **All** to go back.

member-advanced/shortcut-n.text: Press **N** anywhere on the board to jump straight to the new-task box without using the mouse.

member-advanced/export.text: Click **Export CSV** to download every task as `tasks.csv`. It opens in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets.

levels.administrator: Use **Export CSV** to keep a copy of the board before you change categories or permissions.

quick-add/board.text: Start from your board. You do not need to click anything for the next step.

quick-add/press-n.text: Press **N**. The cursor jumps into the new-task box, ready for typing.

quick-add/added.text: Type the task and press **Enter**. It is added with the category that is already selected — no mouse needed.

account/whoami.text: Your name and role always show in the top-right corner, so you can check which account you are using.

account/sign-out.text: Click **Sign out** when you are done, especially on a shared computer.

account/signed-out.text: You are back on the sign-in page. Your tasks stay on the board for next time.

admin-settings/sign-in-admin.text: To manage the team, sign in with the **Admin** role.

admin-settings/settings-link.text: Admins see a **Settings** link in the top bar. Team members do not.

admin-settings/settings-page.text: The Settings page has two parts: **Categories** and **Permissions**.

admin-settings/new-category.text: Type a name for a new category, such as a project or a department.

admin-settings/category-added.text: Click **Add category**. The new category appears in the list and in everyone's category menu straight away.

admin-settings/allow-delete.text: Tick **Team members can delete tasks** if you trust everyone to tidy the board. TaskBoard confirms with **Settings saved.**

levels.administrator: Tick **Team members can delete tasks** to let anyone remove tasks. Leave it unticked if only admins should delete. The change applies at once and shows **Settings saved.**

admin-settings/delete-task.text: Admins (and members, if you allowed it) see a **Delete** button on each task. Deleting cannot be undone.
